title: Knife Skills

learn.summary: Knife skills are the highest-leverage physical skill in cooking: even cuts cook evenly, prep gets faster, and a sharp knife is safer than a dull one because it goes where you point it instead of skidding. Everything builds on two habits — the pinch grip on the blade and the claw on the food. Speed comes from repetition, never from rushing.

do: Dice one onion every day this week using proper grip — by Sunday, time yourself and compare to Monday

children.title: Grip & Claw

learn.summary: Pinch the blade itself between thumb and forefinger just ahead of the handle — not a fist on the handle — for control that steers the knife. The guiding hand curls into a claw, fingertips tucked, knuckles forward so the flat of the blade rides against them and your fingertips are physically unreachable. Slow is smooth; smooth becomes fast.

do: Slice two carrots into coins tonight using pinch grip and claw at half your normal speed, focusing only on knuckle contact with the blade

children.title: Basic Cuts

learn.summary: Master four and you can prep anything: slice, dice (large 3/4 inch, medium 1/2, small 1/4), mince, and chiffonade for leafy herbs. Uniformity beats beauty — a pot of mixed-size potato chunks turns to mush and crunch in the same pan. The onion dice is the gateway drill: horizontal cuts optional, vertical cuts, then crosswise.

do: Practice a medium dice on one potato and check your work: spread the pieces on the board and pull out any piece more than double the size of the smallest

children.title: Sharpening & Care

learn.summary: A honing rod realigns the edge and should be used every few cooks; actual sharpening removes metal and is needed every 6-12 months — a pull-through sharpener is fine to start, a whetstone is better. Test with paper: a sharp knife slices a held sheet cleanly. Hand-wash and dry knives immediately, store on a magnetic strip or in-block, and never let them rattle loose in a drawer.

do: Test your chef's knife on a sheet of paper today; if it tears instead of slicing, sharpen it this week and retest
